summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Panel Manager (Panel Yönetimi) feature. Backend: 29/29 tests passing. Frontend: All CRUD flows verified. Found and fixed 1 critical bug: SelectItem empty-value crash in ExamsTab. Data visibility from admin to user panel verified.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: SelectItem value="" caused React uncaught runtime error crash when Add Exam form opened. Radix UI Select disallows empty string values for SelectItem. Fixed by using value="__none__" and mapping back to empty string.

integration_issues.issue: Stats (Canlı Yayın, Süpervizyon, Sınav counts) are fetched once on PanelManager mount and NOT refreshed when items are added/deleted. Counts remain stale until full page reload.

action_items: MINOR: Refresh stats bar after CRUD operations in PanelManager (call the /api/admin/panel-stats endpoint after each add/delete action to update counts)
critical_code_review_comments: PanelManager.js line 466: SelectItem with value='' was crashing the ExamsTab form - fixed to use __none__ sentinel value.

PanelManager.js StatsBar: stats are only fetched once on component mount (useEffect in PanelManager). After CRUD operations, the stats become stale. Recommend re-fetching stats after successful save/delete operations.

server.py admin_update_live_stream (line 2437): PUT endpoint returns {message: 'Güncellendi'} but NOT the full updated object. Frontend doesn't need it currently (just reloads), but for future frontend use it would be better to return the updated object.
server.py admin_update_supervision/admin_update_exam: Same pattern - returns message only, not the updated document.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All CRUD flows working after SelectItem fix

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data created. Test data was created and deleted during testing.

rca_of_issue.root_cause: Radix UI Select component (shadcn/ui) does not permit SelectItem with value='' (empty string). When BLANK_EXAM has course_id:'' and the form is opened, React renders <SelectItem value=''>— Kurs seçin —</SelectItem> which triggers an uncaught runtime error and crashes the ExamsTab component entirely.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Login to /admin as admin. 2. Go to Panel Yönetimi. 3. Click Sınavlar tab. 4. Click Sınav Ekle button. Crash occurs immediately.
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Changed SelectItem value to '__none__' and mapped onValueChange to convert '__none__' back to '' for the form state.
